people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.
translations.bsb: Brothers, children of Abraham, and you Gentiles who fear God, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.
translations.kjv: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
translations.asv: Brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you that fear God, to us is the word of this salvation sent forth.
